content.brief:
An American convoy is headed south towards the bridge and have orders to capture and hold it until reinforcements arrive. A small German unit is camped in town and are desperate to defend the bridge from capture.
Americans- capture and hold the bridge for 30 seconds
Germans- keep the enemy from reaching their objective for 15 minutes
content.title: Le pont du mal
